question: Who took over as board chair on the day the executive who held a public fireside chat with Kazakhstan's AI minister in Astana on 23 October 2026 stepped down?
key_facts: Harvey C. Jones (also acceptable: Harvey Jones)
appointed Chair of the Board on 11 November 2026

evidence.quote: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang visited Astana
evidence.establishes: The Astana visitor and fireside-chat speaker is Jensen Huang of NVIDIA

evidence.quote: accepted the resignation of Jen-Hsun Huang
evidence.establishes: The 8-K reports the same person, under his legal name, resigning on 11 Nov 2026

evidence.quote: the Board appointed Harvey C. Jones, age 73, as Chair of the Board
evidence.establishes: Jones became Chair the same day

notes: The press-release exhibit 6efa7d34 states the same facts using the name 'Jensen Huang'; it is an acceptable alternative to da5cc113 but does not exercise the alias. Colette Kress (interim CEO) is the tempting wrong answer.

question: A November 2026 paper benchmarks a one-sided expert-parallel all-to-all for mixture-of-experts inference on one GPU generation.
